name: Faylee
summary: Bug reports with screen, console and network in one link that your coding agent can fix via MCP.
description: Faylee is a Chrome extension that records the screen, console, network requests and steps behind a bug on one timeline and shares it as a link; secrets are redacted in the browser. Its MCP server lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode read the report and fix the bug. Free for 3 members and 30 recordings/month; Team $15 per recording member/month.
